name: mwd_get_payment_request_demo
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mwd_get_payment_request_demo(p_payment_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ DECLARE v_request public.mwd_payment_requests%rowtype; v_name text; v_actor uuid := auth.uid(); BEGIN IF v_actor IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Debes iniciar sesion'; END IF; IF p_payment_id IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Solicitud invalida'; END IF; SELECT * INTO v_request FROM public.mwd_payment_requests WHERE id=p_payment_id AND (status='pending' OR merchant_user_id=v_actor); IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Solicitud no disponible'; END IF; SELECT business_name INTO v_name FROM public.mwd_merchants WHERE owner_user_id=v_request.merchant_user_id; RETURN jsonb_build_object('id',v_request.id,'business_name',v_name,'amount_cents',v_request.amount_cents,'currency_code',v_request.currency_code,'status',v_request.status,'description',v_request.description); END $function$

name: mwd_owner_partner_audit_feed_demo
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mwd_owner_partner_audit_feed_demo(p_country_code text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_partner_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_limit integer DEFAULT 50)
 RETURNS TABLE(audit_id bigint, partner_id uuid, partner_name text, country_code text, entity_type text, action text, actor_id uuid, changed_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 PERFORM mwd_partners_private.assert_owner();
 IF p_country_code IS NOT NULL AND p_country_code !~ '^[A-Z]{2}$' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Código de país inválido' USING ERRCODE='22023';
 END IF;
 IF p_limit IS NULL OR p_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 100 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Límite de consulta inválido' USING ERRCODE='22023';
 END IF;
 RETURN QUERY
 SELECT a.id,p.id,p.legal_name,p.country_code,a.entity_type,a.action,a.actor_id,a.changed_at
 FROM mwd_partners_private.change_audit a
 JOIN mwd_partners_private.partners p ON p.id=CASE
   WHEN a.entity_type='partners' THEN a.entity_id
   WHEN a.entity_type IN ('locations','due_diligence_reviews','engagements')
    THEN NULLIF(COALESCE(a.after_row->>'partner_id',a.before_row->>'partner_id'),'')::uuid
   ELSE NULL::uuid END
 WHERE (p_country_code IS NULL OR p.country_code=p_country_code)
   AND (p_partner_id IS NULL OR p.id=p_partner_id)
 ORDER BY a.changed_at DESC,a.id DESC
 LIMIT p_limit;
END;
$function$
